_comment: klt erc supply spec for layout/gds/tmds_encoder.gds -- the block's T1
item 11 (power delivery, structural) artifact, per klayout-tools
docs/design-evidence-tiers.md item 11 (approved as klayout-tools#2025,
Run:
klt erc layout/gds/tmds_encoder.gds layout/erc-supply-spec.json \
--format json > layout/erc_reports/tmds_encoder.erc.json
What this spec asserts, and why each piece is shaped this way:
- stackup[0] MUST carry role: "gate" (klt erc's own contract,
docs/cli/erc.md 'Spec file'), so the stack starts at Poly2 30/0, not
Metal1. active_layer Comp 22/0 makes the antenna denominator
poly-AND-diff instead of raw poly area, per #1979 -- a routed design's
filltie/decap/filler poly bars carry no gate oxide, and the declared-
supply verdicts below must not rest on geometry that treats them as
gates.
- Metal1-Metal5 are the layers this block's PDN actually routes on
(flow/tmds_encoder/pnr/pdn.tcl: Metal1 -followpins rails, Metal4 and
Metal5 straps, -pins {Metal5}), so every strap layer is covered by
this stackup, which item 11's digital column requires.
- Layer numbers are gf180mcu's own drawn-layer numbers, derived from the
PDK's own libs.tech/klayout/tech/gf180mcu.lyp (gf180mcuD, open_pdks
c6d73a35f5..., pinned per sim/pdk.json and DR-0010) AND cross-checked
against klayout-tools' curated gf180mcu deck layer table
(src/klayout_tools/decks/gf180mcu.py) -- not copied from another
PDK's spec. All twelve numbers agree between the two sources.
- label_layer belongs only on layers this block's merged GDS actually
puts supply text on, verified against the GDS itself, not assumed:
- Metal1 34/10 (PDK name Metal1_Label): 1385 'VDD' + 1385 'VSS'
texts -- the standard cells' own PG pin text on their M1 rails.
- Metal5 81/10 (PDK name Metal5_Label): exactly one 'VDD' + one
'VSS' -- the PDN's own top-level supply pin text
(define_pdn_grid -pins {Metal5}).
- Metal4 46/10 (PDK name Metal4_Label) is deliberately NOT declared:
this GDS puts 23 texts there and every one is a signal pin
(clk, ctrl[i], data[i], de, rst, tmds[i]) -- declaring it would add
nothing to net naming.
- nets[]: VDD and VSS both kind: "supply", which is what makes a short
between them report as the severe erc.supply_short rather than the
general erc.multiply_driven_net. Each must resolve to exactly ONE
electrical island: erc.unconnected_net fires on zero matches (nothing
in the layout carries that label at all) AND on more than one (the
rail is split into pieces that never touch), so zero findings of
that rule is exactly the 'one island per supply' verdict, not merely
an absence. The split-rail case is precisely the no-PDN failure mode
item 11 exists to detect (klayout-tools#2025's fleet survey found 2
of 7 committed digital layouts with exactly that hole).
- There is deliberately NO ties[] section here, and that is a recorded
gap rather than an oversight: klt erc's ties[] collapses a real
routed standard-cell design into one electrical island and reports a
FALSE erc.supply_short (upstream klayout-tools#2169, reproduced four
ways in gf180-drone-fc's FRICTION F-034). Because ties[] is omitted,
erc.missing_tie is NOT COMPUTED by this run (docs/cli/erc.md:
'Omitted entirely -> erc.missing_tie is never computed') -- any zero
count for it in the committed report is an absence of evidence, not
evidence of absence. Standing-in well-tie evidence, named per issue
- tapcell insertion in the flow that built this GDS:
flow/pnr_tmds_encoder.py runs
tapcell -distance 100 -tapcell_master gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu9t5v0__filltie
-endcap_master gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu9t5v0__endcap;
- the standard cells' own PG pin labels are present in the merged
GDS (1385 VDD + 1385 VSS texts on 34/10, per above), and
layout/lvs_reports/tmds_encoder.lvs.json reports status: "match"
with VDD->VDD and VSS->VSS pairs in net_correspondence -- its SPICE
reference carries the supply nets, so the rails' connectivity was
part of that compare rather than absent from it.
Full verification of well ties stays open until klayout-tools#2169
is fixed and a ties[] section can be declared without manufacturing
a false supply_short.
